text:
ellie: kicking off canary for newtix11b int4. baseline fp16 p50=110ms p95=340ms. int4 canary shows p50=220ms p95=640ms, occasional OOMs on long contexts. @sam any initial thoughts?

sam: saw similar. quick bench:
```
baseline fp16: p50 110ms p95 340ms
int4 (prefetch on): p50 220ms p95 640ms, OOM x3/1000
int4 (prefetch off): p50 125ms p95 360ms, OOM 0/1000
```

deepa: looks like prefetch_kv is causing fragmentation with int4 memory layout. disabling prefetch helped in the lab. also observed KV cache stripes at allocation time.

jen: good catch. propose model defaults for newtix11b:
```
quant: int4
prefetch_kv: false
max_new_tokens: 256
default_batch_size: 4
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.66
slot_reserve: 0.08
```

ellie: +1 to lowering max_new_tokens, most user prompts <200. I'll open a canary config PR and push to canary pool.

sam: link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 — added a rollout that sets prefetch_kv=false and limits max_new_tokens.

perf-bot: Canary rollout deployed to 10% nodes at 2026-03-21T16:12:00Z. Observed metrics (1h): p50=128ms, p95=370ms, OOMs=0.

ellie: rolling to 100% tomorrow unless objections. We'll also add an eval to catch quality regressions from int4.

deepa: will run the quantized QA eval suite overnight and report deltas.

jen: add a note to the onboarding doc about prefetch_kv caveat for int4 models: https://confluence.redwood.com/models/newtix11b-onboard

sam: thanks everyone. closing thread after the canary completes.
